catalogScope: Manufacturer products, services and named platform capabilities. Dell-delivered offerings and beta integrations are clearly identified.
heroAlt: Wasabi illustration showing cloud data protected by access controls, identity verification and a security shield

products.name: Wasabi Hot Cloud Storage
products.description: S3-compatible object storage for backups, archives, media libraries and application data, with immediate access rather than retrieval from a cold tier.

products.name: Wasabi Fire
products.description: Low-latency cloud object storage designed for AI, media processing and interactive applications that need fast reads and writes.
products.imageAlt: Wasabi server illustration for low-latency storage
products.source: Brand_Guidelines_2024_Draft_10.pdf, page 22; current Wasabi Fire page

products.name: Wasabi AI Storage
products.description: Keep training datasets, model checkpoints and artifacts in an S3-compatible object layer that connects to your chosen compute environment. This is a storage solution for AI workflows, rather than a separate storage SKU.
features: Storage for datasets and model artifacts
products.imageAlt: Wasabi AI-brain illustration for AI data and model storage
products.source: Current Wasabi AI Storage solution page, checked November 2, 2026; Brand_Guidelines_2024_Draft_10.pdf, page 22

products.name: Wasabi Cloud NAS
products.description: Extend existing file storage into the cloud while keeping a familiar file-based workflow for users and applications.
features: Offload selected data from local storage
products.source: Cloud Nas Data Sheet.pdf; Brand_Guidelines_2024_Draft_10.pdf, page 22

products.name: Wasabi Surveillance Cloud
products.description: Pair cloud-bridge software with object storage to extend the capacity of a compatible on-premises video management system.
features: Review camera count, bitrate and retention
products.source: 2025 Wasabi for Video Surveillance Presentation.pdf; current product page; brand illustration

products.name: Covert Copy
products.description: A built-in Wasabi protection capability for keeping a hidden recovery copy of selected data with tightly controlled access.
products.source: Covert-Copy-One-Pager.pdf; current manufacturer explanation; brand illustration

products.name: Wasabi Object Replication
products.description: Maintain additional copies of bucket data across Wasabi locations to support a recovery or data-placement plan.
products.source: Current manufacturer storage tools page; Brand_Guidelines_2024_Draft_10.pdf, page 22

products.name: Wasabi Cloud Sync Manager
products.description: A managed migration service for moving object data from supported cloud or on-premises storage into Wasabi.
products.source: Current manufacturer page and docs.wasabi.com/wcsm-wasabi-cloud-sync-manager; brand illustration

products.name: Wasabi Ball Transfer Appliance
products.description: Load a rented transfer appliance on your local network, then return it for data ingestion into Wasabi when online transfer is impractical.
features: Rental and regional availability by quote
products.source: Current manufacturer product page; brand illustration

products.name: Wasabi Direct Connect
products.description: Connect a data center or supported cloud environment to Wasabi using private network connectivity instead of the public internet.
products.source: Current manufacturer Direct Connect page; brand illustration

products.name: Wasabi Account Control Manager
products.description: Manage multiple Wasabi accounts from a central platform, with account provisioning, usage visibility and billing workflows.
products.source: Wasabi Account Control Manager Data Sheet.pdf; current product page; brand illustration

products.name: Custom Cloud Console
products.description: A white-label storage console for eligible Wasabi Account Control Manager deployments, giving end customers a branded interface for their storage.
products.source: Wasabi Account Control Manager Data Sheet.pdf, page 3; current CCC documentation; brand illustration

products.name: Wasabi Account Control API
products.description: Connect your own provisioning and service-management software to supported Wasabi account operations through an API.
products.source: Current product terms: Account Control Manager and API; brand illustration

products.name: Wasabi with Dell ObjectScale
products.description: A Dell-delivered storage offering with capped reserved capacity. Contract scope and purchase route are confirmed with Dell.
products.source: Current product terms: Wasabi with Dell ObjectScale; brand illustration

products.name: Wasabi Surveillance Cloud with Dell ObjectScale
products.description: Combine the Surveillance Cloud bridge with the Dell ObjectScale offering for video retention. Available through Dell.
products.imageAlt: Wasabi video-camera illustration for surveillance storage
products.source: Current product terms: Wasabi Surveillance Cloud with Dell ObjectScale; brand illustration

products.name: Wasabi Cloud NAS with Dell ObjectScale
products.description: Combine Cloud NAS file-gateway software with the Dell ObjectScale storage offering. Available through Dell.
products.source: Current product terms: Wasabi Cloud NAS with Dell ObjectScale; brand illustration

products.name: Wasabi Explorer
products.description: Browse and manage Wasabi storage with an S3 client. Review the supported client version and system requirements before installing.
products.source: Current Wasabi Explorer documentation; brand illustration

products.name: Wasabi Premium Support
products.description: Select a manufacturer support plan for your Wasabi deployment when your operational requirements extend beyond basic support.
features: Confirm service scope in the quote
products.source: Current manufacturer support page; brand illustration

products.name: Wasabi MCP (beta)
products.description: Connect compatible AI agents to Wasabi storage through the manufacturer's beta Model Context Protocol integration.
products.imageAlt: Wasabi puzzle-piece illustration for the MCP beta integration
products.source: Current Wasabi AI Storage page lists Wasabi MCP as beta; brand illustration
